rationale: The original thesis relied on XE reclaiming and holding session VWAP ($10.17) and its 5-minute 9-EMA ($10.15), yet after 24 minutes and a peak move of +1.03% (reaching at least $10.26), the stock has failed to sustain momentum and dropped back to $10.12. Breaking below both VWAP and the 5-minute 9-EMA invalidates the immediate breakout continuation structure, making an early exit at a small loss (-$7.63) preferable to risking the full stop at $10.03 given the tight $173.96 remaining daily loss budget.
